comparison.objective: Candidate removes one connector terminal; record locks out an AC disconnect by removing, reversing, reinserting, closing, and padlocking it.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine blade-under-tab insertion and wire-tool pull versus cover support, large pull-out reorientation, reinsertion, and padlock latching.
comparison.success_condition: One terminal removed without damage or neighbor release versus AC-1 visibly OFF, seated, covered, and locked without disturbing AC-2.
comparison.reason: Both include removal, but the record tests keyed reconfiguration and lockout sequencing rather than recessed latch release.
